title: Open a member sub-account
description: Open a new sub-account for a member, funded from one of their existing accounts, and record the reference number and new account number the console gives back once it is opened.

fundingAccount.description: the existing account to fund it from

memberId.description: the member to open a sub-account for

nickname.description: a label for the new sub-account

Same flow, same steps, same outputs.
